title: Which L6 suits you?
text: Tell us how you drive and we'll show you the right version – and what the energy would cost you each month.

inputs.dailyKm: How far you drive on a typical day
inputs.longTripsValue: {count, plural, =0 {rarely or never} one {one a month} other {# a month}}
inputs.homeCharging: Can you charge at home or at work?

result.label: Our recommendation
result.saving: About {amount} lei saved per year compared with a petrol SUV.

reasons.allElectric: Your {dailyKm} km a day fit {times} times into a single charge, and at home you leave every morning with a full battery.
reasons.noHomeCharging: Without charging at home, the PHEV stays efficient as a hybrid and you refuel as quickly as you do today.
reasons.longTrips: With frequent long trips, the 1,058 km combined range spares you planning your stops. In the city, you drive electric {share}% of the day.
reasons.dailyBeyondRange: At {dailyKm} km a day, the PHEV gives you the freedom not to depend on charging, with up to 1,058 km of combined range.

footnote: Indicative calculation for everyday driving (30 days a month), based on WLTP consumption: L6 PHEV 14.8 kWh/100 km electric and 5.9 l/100 km with a depleted battery; L6 BEV about 14.5 kWh/100 km (estimated from battery capacity and range until the homologated value is published); reference petrol SUV 7.5 l/100 km. Prices are indicative – adjust them to your own tariffs. Real costs differ.
